content.name: Priyanka Desai
content.title: Principal Data Scientist
content.summary: Principal data scientist with 15 years in agriculture, insurance, telecom and energy trading. Lead a data science group of nine at a Calgary natural gas marketer, where our price and demand forecasting platform informs about $1.8 billion in annual trading volume. Accredited P.Stat. with a track record of getting models out of notebooks and into daily decisions.

experience.title: Principal Data Scientist
bullets: Lead nine data scientists and ML engineers across forecasting, risk and customer analytics, with a $2.6 million annual budget.
Delivered a gas demand forecasting platform using hierarchical models and weather ensembles, lowering day-ahead forecast error by 19% and informing roughly $1.8 billion in yearly volume.
Established model risk governance with the CRO: model cards, validation sign-off and drift monitoring for all 23 production models.
Hired and onboarded five team members and created a promotion framework with clear expectations for each level.

experience.title: Senior Data Scientist
bullets: Built a customer lifetime value model for 1.2 million wireless subscribers that reshaped retention offers and reduced postpaid churn by 0.4 points a month.
Developed network capacity forecasts that deferred $14 million in tower upgrades without breaching service targets.
Led a team of three on a bilingual call transcript classifier that routed English and French complaints with 91% accuracy.

experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Created a hail claims severity model using radar and policy data, shortening catastrophe reserve estimates from two weeks to two days after major storms.
Introduced fraud propensity scoring for auto claims, increasing the hit rate of special investigations referrals from 18% to 31%.
Partnered with underwriting to retire 40 manual rating rules after validating them against loss experience.

experience.title: Research Analyst
bullets: Modelled crop yield from satellite vegetation indices for 3,000 townships, supporting grain marketing reports sold to 60 subscribers.
Wrote R packages for data cleaning that cut weekly report production from three days to one.
Presented yield outlooks at two provincial agriculture conferences.
